goal: Apply an integer rate with half-up rounding.

must.text: applyRateMinor(minor, numerator, denominator) returns the integer half-up value of minor times numerator over denominator. All arguments are non-negative integers and the denominator is positive.

rule_text: applyRateMinor(minor, numerator, denominator) returns the integer half-up value of minor times numerator over denominator. All arguments are non-negative integers and the denominator is positive.
